scope:
Coupled Geant4 response and consistently rebuilt plant accounts.

Nested transport responses describe the all-cold response basis before each
row's explicit plant routing.
Transport scenarios and extra missed-hot sensitivities are not model probability
intervals. Material recovery is a separate, closed-reservoir account.

precursor_cycle.preparation_policy: Driver uses precursor input; preparation radiation gets no useful electric-recovery credit. Its cold/external destination is selected separately. Existing energy_capture_fraction applies only to hot-burn heat boundary.
precursor_cycle.energy_capture_fraction_scope: Comparison policy:99% of the hot-burn boundary, preparation input increment escaping externally. Other preparation destinations need explicit cold/source partition.

transport_response_before_plant_routing.scope: Conditional source-response estimate, not an energy-maximum theorem or full-device capture guarantee. Natural graphite; closed spherical cavity; two-photon in-flight annihilation approximation. Missing photonuclear physics is isolated by prompt-policy sensitivity. No extra nuclear energy is created by D uplift.

plant.scope: Conditional stationary heat/power/mass requirements. Hot eligibility, insulation, converter/HX/pump ratings and cold-sky view require hardware qualification. Original generic services retained; named HX and pump hardware are incremental allocations.
plant.surface_proxy_scope: Sum of separate maxima in constant-property carbon; prompt mathematical-surface deposition is an intentionally conservative reference, not a qualified physical temperature. Finite spectral penetration and delayed heat require separate treatment.
plant.processing_cost_scope: These named H-processing loads are compared with the retained ordinary-auxiliary allowance; they are not additional debits on top of an allowance already intended to cover processing. New requirements exceeding that allowance must be added explicitly.
plant.qualification: Conditional integrated accounting point. Source formation, receiver recovery and guide/thermal hardware remain engineering candidates.

interpretation: Pulse transport weights use the actual hot family. The source electrical and storage accounts use the explicit precursor input. Already escaped preparation radiation is allocated exactly once.
The additional 0, 0.5%, and 1% missed-hot sensitivities multiply the complete non-neutrino nuclear plus precursor input energy. They are scenarios, not imposed physical requirements.
Primary rows send all missed hot energy, including preparation radiation, to cold equipment. External-escape rows require a different geometry.
Geant4 sampling intervals do not include uncertain source geometry, spectrum, opacity or component performance.
Whole-plant mass and heat accounts are conditional on source, receiver and support hardware meeting their stated requirements. No material disappearance is inferred from energy leakage.
